title: Human IFN?/Granzyme B Dual Color ELISpot
author: Miloje Savic

steps_raw.instruction: Human IFNγ/Granzyme B Dual Color ELISpot
Miloje Savic and Jennifer L. Dembinski
Infection Control and Environmental Health, Norwegian Institute of Public Health, Oslo, Norway

This protocol describes the preparation and use of ELISpot 96 well plates for measuring human IFNγ and Granzyme B production by immune cells (notably CD4 and CD8 T cells). Cells harvested from peripheral blood or other organs can be used, stimulated with antigen of interest (usually between 18 to 24h), and per cell production of IFNγ and Granzyme B measured as a ‘spot’ on a plate well membrane (http://www.immunospot.eu/advantage-of-immunospot-kits.html).
CTL (http://www.immunospot.eu/) Human IFNγ/Granzyme B Dual Color ELISPot plates
CTL provided solutions: Capture Solution, Detection Solution, Tertiary Solution, Blue Developer and Red Developer Solution (see Solutions)
Washing buffer (see Solutions)
Sterile disposable tips
Important: Work under sterile conditions, ideally in a laminar flow class II biosafety cabinet
•	Prepare IFNγ/GranzymeB Capture Solution and prepare 70% ethanol (see Solutions).
•	Remove underdrain from 96 well plate before pipetting 15µl of 70% EtOH in each well. After filling entire plate immediately add 150µl PBS to each well and wash additional 3 times with 150µl PBS.
•	Pipette 80µl/well IFNγ/GranzymeB Capture Solution and replace underdrain (be careful not to puncture the well membranes). Seal the plate and incubate at 4˚C overnight.
Important: Work under sterile conditions, ideally in a laminar flow class II biosafety cabinet

•	Thaw, wash and prepare PBMC; bring to a concentration of 4million cells/ml in Aim-V media (ThermoFisher Scientific). Let the cells ‘rest’ in a 37˚C humidified 5% CO2 incubator while preparing plate.
•	Decant plate with IFNγ/GranzymeB Capture Solution from Day 0 and wash 1x with 150µl PBS.

•	Plate the antigen/mitogen solutions: 100µl Aim-V media/well, then 50µl of each antigen/mitogen solution/well. Place the plate in a 37˚C humidified 5% CO2 incubator for 15 minutes to ensure ideal temperature/pH.
•	Add gently 50µl of the prepared PBMC solution per well.
•	Immediately place plate back into the 37˚C humidified 5% CO2 incubator and incubate for 18-24 hours.
Important: DO NOT STACK PLATES and AVOID SHAKING THE PLATES. Carefully open/close the laminar flow cabinet door and DO NOT TOUCH PLATES DURING THE INCUBATION.
•	Prepare wash solutions for the day: PBS, distilled water and Tween-PBS (see Wash Buffers).
•	Prepare IFNγ/GranzymeB Detection Solution (see Solutions).
•	Wash plate 2x with PBS and then 2x with 0.05% Tween-PBS, 200µl/well each time.
•	Add 80µl/well IFNγ/GranzymeB Detection Solution. Incubate at room temperature, 2h.
•	Prepare Tertiary Solution (see Solutions).
•	Wash plate 3x with 0.05% Tween-PBS, 200µl/well.
•	Add 80µl/well of Tertiary Solution (see Solutions). Incubate at room temperature, 30 minutes.
•	Prepare Red and Blue Developer Solution (see Solutions).
•	Wash plate 2x with 0.05% Tween-PBS, and then 2x with distilled water, 200µl/well each time.
•	Add Blue Developer Solution, 80µl/well. Incubate at RT, 15-20 minutes.
•	Stop reaction by gently rinsing membrane with tap water, decant, and repeat 3x.
•	Decant plate, wash with tap water and wash once more with distilled water, 200µl/well.
•	Add Red Developer Solution, 80µl/well. Incubate at room temperature 5-10 minutes.
•	Remove protective underdrain of the plate and rinse back of plate with tap water.
•	Air dry plate for 2h in a running hood or 24h face down on paper towels on bench top.
•	Scan and count plate (e.g. CTL ImmunoSpot Analyzer):
IFNγ spots are Red colored
Granzyme B spots are Blue colored
For more details see CTL Protocol Human IFN-γ / Granzyme B Double-Color Enzymatic ELISPOT Assay:
http://www.immunospot.com/includes/pdfs/protocols2/Hu_GrzB_IFNG_DC_Enz_Protocol.pdf
Human IFNγ/Granzyme B Dual Color Enzymatic Solutions
Important: All solutions should be freshly made prior to use
•	70% ethanol: Dilute 190-200 proof Ethanol. For 10ml, add 7ml of ethanol to 3ml of distilled water
•	Capture Solution: Dilute IFNγ Capture Antibody and GranzymeB Capture Antibody in Diluent A. For 1 plate, add 40µl of IFNγ Capture Antibody and 80µl of GranzymeB Capture Antibody to 10ml Diluent A.

•	Detection Solution: Dilute IFNγ Detection Antibody and GranzymeB Detection Antibody in Diluent B. For 1 plate, add 40µl of IFNγ Detection Antibody and 10µl of GranzymeB Detection Antibody to 10ml of Diluent B.
•	Tertiary Solution: Dilute Strep-AP 1:1000 and FITC-HRP 1:1000 in Diluent C. For 1 plate, add 10µl of Strep-AP and 10µl of FITC-HRP to 10ml of Diluent C.
•	Blue Developer Solution: To develop GranzymeB spots, add the substrate solutions in sequential steps to 10ml Diluent Blue. For 1 plate:
o	Step 1 - Add 160µl of S1 to 10ml Diluent Blue. Mix well!
o	Step 2 – Add 160µl of S2. Mix well!
o	Step 3 – Add 92µl of S3. Mix well!
•	Red Developer Solution: To develop IFNγ spots, add the substrate solutions in sequential steps to 10ml of Diluent Red. For 1 plate:
o	Step 1 – Add 180µl of R1 to 10ml of Diluent Red. Mix well!
o	Step 2 – Add 160µl of R2. Mix well!
Important: It is recommended to prepare both the Blue and Red Developer Solutions within 10 minutes of use and to keep them protected from light.
Wash Buffers (not included in the kit)
For each plate prepare:
•	0.05% Tween-PBS: 75µl Tween-20 in 150ml PBS
•	PBS, sterile, 100ml
•	Distilled water, 100ml
